About Us

Built by students, for builders

AWS SBG KITW is the official AWS Student Builder Group at Kakatiya Institute of Technology & Science for Women, Nizamabad. We exist to make cloud computing, AI/ML, and modern software building accessible, hands-on, and genuinely fun for every student who wants in — regardless of where they're starting from.

We're not a lecture series. We're a builder community: workshops you can actually apply, projects you can actually ship, and a network that actually shows up for you.

What We Do

Our Agenda

Six ways we turn curiosity into shipped, real-world skill — four confirmed, two more on the way.

🛠️

Workshops

Hands-on sessions covering AWS core services, cloud fundamentals, and emerging tech — led by peers, mentors, and industry practitioners. Come with questions, leave with working deployments.

☁️

AWS Cloud Quest

Learn cloud concepts through AWS's gamified, role-playing learning experience. Level up across Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect, and Developer tracks while competing and collaborating with fellow builders.

🤝

Build with KIRO

Team up on real, collaborative builds using KIRO. This is where individual learning turns into shipped projects — the kind you'll want on your resume and in your portfolio.

⚡

Hack-a-thons

Time-boxed, high-energy events where teams design, build, and pitch solutions to real problems. Compete, prototype fast, and walk away with a project, a network, and a story.

✨
